task_title: AUG-121: model each Auger task as a scoped XML spec with in/out references, acceptance+verification refs and ch:trace links
task_criteria: AC1 - a task XML block's stable id, lifecycle/version, in-scope refs, out-of-scope refs with reasons, acceptance refs and verification methods are typed and resolve to existing blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.

AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or skips, or fewer than 5 pass.

AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches, with boardctl present on the proof PATH. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS (a skip means the boardctl readback never ran), or the readback differs from the approved packet.

AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or a canonical JSONL hash changes.

AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.

AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.

items.criterion: AC1 - a task XML block's stable id, lifecycle/version, in-scope refs, out-of-scope refs with reasons, acceptance refs and verification methods are typed and resolve to existing blocks. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_task_scope_contract. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or pytest reports fewer than 1 passed.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit 0, output `1 passed in 0.16s`. The test (tests/test_xml_task_contract.py:186-250) asserts the packet's typed fields (task/source/status/version/method/scope_version) and typed entries for in_scope/acceptance/out_of_scope carrying kind/status/version/source/edge plus `reason` on exclusions, then cross-checks every named id against `spec list` output (`named <= known`). Implementation: auger.task_packet / _task_packet_entry at auger.py:9527-9580; grammar declared in specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:216-262.

items.criterion: AC2 - duplicate, missing, inactive-without-acknowledgment and cross-version spec references are refused with a typed finding naming the exact task and block ids and emitting no partial task packet. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_task_naming_a_missing_block_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_multiple_scope_refusals_are_typed tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_inactive_reference_needs_acknowledgment tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_a_cross_version_reference_is_refused tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_out_of_scope_entry_without_a_reason_is_refused. FAILIF: any of the five tests fails or skips, or fewer than 5 pass.
items.detail: Ran the exact 5-test proof: exit 0, output `5 passed in 0.44s` (no skips; re-run with -rs also clean). Each refusal is a distinct typed code naming task+block: unresolved-reference (auger.py:8573), task-duplicate-reference (8634/8669), task-scope-conflict (8640), task-invalid-acceptance-ref (8647), inactive-reference-unacknowledged (8655), missing-exclusion-reason (8674/8682), unexpected-exclusion (8689), cross-version-reference (8700). Tests assert `out == ""` so no partial packet is emitted, and the task-packet verb also exits 2 with empty stdout.

items.criterion: AC3 - given an approved plan digest, exporting one task through boardctl records the exact in-scope and excluded block ids plus their source version in supported fields and the readback matches, with boardctl present on the proof PATH. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_approved_plan_digest_exports_one_board_row. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS (a skip means the boardctl readback never ran), or the readback differs from the approved packet.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit 0, output `1 passed in 0.08s` — not skipped (boardctl resolves at /home/kara/.local/bin/boardctl, so boardctl_or_skip() does not fire). The test initialises a real board via `boardctl init`, exports with --plan-digest, and reads back with `boardctl show`; it asserts capability_tags == ["in-scope:SG7-REQ-1@1.0.0","acceptance:SG7-AC-1@1.0.0","out-of-scope:SG7-REQ-9@1.0.0"], that the canonical packet JSON appears verbatim in reasoning, that row == result["readback"], and that a repeat export returns "unchanged" with exactly one row. Row construction: auger.task_board_row (auger.py:9834-9873); readback comparison: auger.py:9960-9975.

items.criterion: AC4 - given an unapproved or stale plan digest, boardctl is not invoked and both canonical JSONL files stay byte-identical. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_an_unapproved_or_stale_digest_leaves_the_board_untouched. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or a canonical JSONL hash changes.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit 0, output `1 passed in 0.06s`, not skipped. The test sha256-hashes tasks.jsonl and events.jsonl before/after and asserts equality, asserts typed codes unapproved-plan-digest / stale-plan-digest / invalid-plan-digest with empty stdout, and asserts a recording boardctl wrapper log was never created (`assert not log.exists()`), i.e. boardctl was not invoked. Structurally confirmed: export_task_packet calls require_approved_plan (auger.py:9596-9622) before the first _board_readback/_boardctl call at auger.py:9930.

items.criterion: AC5 - a task packet's ch:trace marker resolves row and spec to the canonical task and exact XML ids, while absent evidence/verdict/commit fields use none:reason. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_generated_trace_marker_resolves. FAILIF: the test fails, is not collected, or skips, or a marker field is missing instead of carrying none:reason.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit 0, output `1 passed in 0.04s`. The test asserts row==SG7-TASK-1, spec==tasks.xml#SG7-TASK-1, test==tests/test_xml_specs.py::test_gate_runs_these_tests, and that evidence/verdict/commit each startswith "none:" with len>5; resolve_trace_marker returns blocks==["SG7-TASK-1"], missing==[], and scope ids {SG7-REQ-1,SG7-AC-1,SG7-REQ-9} each with source ending "#<id>". A bare `none` raises unexplained-absent-field (auger.py:9735-9740). Marker rendering: auger.py:9650-9675.

items.criterion: AC6 - out of scope holds: the exporter invokes only boardctl create/readback with no scheduler mutation client, and its proof file is named in the gate pytest arm. PROOF: cd /home/kara/auger && PATH=$PWD/.venv/bin:$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH python3 -m pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_the_exporter_only_invokes_boardctl_create_and_readback tests/test_xml_task_contract.py::test_gate_arm_runs_these_files. FAILIF: either test fails, is not collected, or SKIPS, or tests/gate.sh does not name tests/test_xml_task_contract.py.
items.detail: Ran the exact proof: exit 0, output `2 passed in 0.08s`, not skipped. The wrapper log's operations set must equal {"create","show"}; the exporter source (export_task_packet + _boardctl) is asserted free of urllib/http.client/requests/socket/scheduler/tick. tests/gate.sh:206 contains the pytest arm and it names `tests/test_xml_task_contract.py` (verified by grep on the arm line).

items.criterion: The task-export path is reachable from the CLI entrypoint (spec task-export registered in auger.main's spec dispatch and argparse), not just callable as a Python function.
items.detail: `python3 auger.py spec task-export --help` exits 0 and prints usage with root/--task/--board/--plan-digest/--boardctl. Parser registered at auger.py:14173-14190, dispatched at auger.py:12676-12677 to cmd_spec_task_export (auger.py:11834) which calls export_task_packet (auger.py:9876). `spec task-packet` likewise dispatched at auger.py:12674-12675.

items.criterion: The exporter's refusal path is ordered so no boardctl invocation can precede the approval check (require_approved_plan before any _boardctl call), i.e. AC4's "boardctl is not invoked" holds structurally, not only in the test.
items.detail: export_task_packet (auger.py:9876-9930) runs load_spec_corpus -> task_packet -> require_approved_plan(packet, declared) and only then `existing = _board_readback(...)` at auger.py:9930; require_approved_plan raises unapproved/invalid/stale-plan-digest at auger.py:9596-9622. Independently corroborated by the AC4 test's recording-wrapper assertion that no boardctl invocation log exists.

items.criterion: The new <task>/<exclusion> grammar is declared in the shipped XSD (specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd) so a task corpus validates against the schema, and the schema-conformance suite stays green.
items.detail: specs/schema/auger-spec-1.0.xsd:216-262 declares `<xs:element name="task" type="auger:taskType">` with in-scope/out-of-scope/acceptance/acknowledges/scope-version/plan-digest attributes and the `<exclusion ref reason>` element; tests/test_xsd_conformance.py is green in the combined run (`98 passed in 5.70s`).

items.criterion: The whole proof file plus the neighbouring spec suites stay green (no regression introduced by the new grammar/verbs).
items.detail: `pytest -q tests/test_xml_task_contract.py` -> `11 passed in 0.30s`; `pytest -q tests/test_spec_context.py tests/test_task_packet.py tests/test_plan_approval.py tests/test_xsd_conformance.py tests/test_xml_specs.py` -> `98 passed in 5.70s`, exit 0. A combined run of all 11 named proof tests with -rs -> `11 passed in 0.68s`, no skips.

items.criterion: The trace marker's spec= value resolves to the exact XML block source (file.xml#ID) and a stale/foreign file reference is refused rather than silently accepted.
items.detail: render_task_trace_marker sets spec=packet["source"] (auger.py:9650-9675), which is the block's `file.xml#ID` source; resolve_trace_marker (auger.py:9745-9805) raises unknown-spec-id for a missing block and stale-spec-ref when block["source_file"] != the named file. AC5 test asserts spec == "tasks.xml#SG7-TASK-1" and that every scope entry's source endswith "#"+id.
